subject: Request: Accelerator top-up + blended discount exception for Campfire Inc.
messages:
From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@campfire.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vcbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension + credits/top-up request (Campfire)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the strong onboarding support from your team. Our pilot is driving a surprising amount of value for our search pipeline (we saw 3x improvement in intent classification precision last week), but usage is spiking faster than we forecasted. Two asks from our side:

1) A 3-week extension on the current accelerator pilot window (we need more runway to validate the longer-tail user flows).
2) A combined incentive: a top-up of free inference credits (~$15k net usage value) paired with a blended discount on the first month of committed usage (we were thinking 20% off).

We understand this is outside standard playbook, so we wanted to surface the business rationale: our customer cohort shows clear conversion signals; with a little runway and a softer price during ramp we will convert to paid usage and expand to two more product teams within Campfire. Liam (cc’d) is advising on the commercial side.

Attached: usage_report_Q3.pdf (shows token/day and conversion signal), and the signed_MSA for reference.

Can you confirm whether this is something Redwood can approve at your level or whether you need an exec exception? We’re under time pressure to avoid throttling actual users.

Best,
Sasha Nguyen
Head of ML Product, Campfire Inc.
---- Attachment: usage_report_Q3.pdf (PDF, 78KB)
---- Attachment: signed_MSA.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot extension + credits/top-up request (Campfire) — recs for exec approval

Team — forwarding Campfire's ask (below). Quick summary and proposed path:

What they want: 3-week pilot extension + ~$15k credits + 20% one-month discount.
Why: high engagement and strong early conversion signals; risk of churn if we throttle.
Business case: campfire is an early-stage but high-velocity buyer (VC-backed, pilot across two product teams next quarter). There is an active exec at VC partner (Liam) pushing for a smoother start.

My recommended exception (to keep runway but control cost/risk):
- Offer $7,500 in free inference credits now (applied to the accelerator account).
- Approve a 12% blended discount on month-one committed usage.
- Add a conditional clause: if they sign a 3-month minimum commit of $25k/month within 14 days, top-up an additional $5k credits (total $12.5k).

Rationale: halves the upfront exposure while creating a clear commit path. We preserve leverage and tie extra concessions to conversion.

Please reply with a 👍 / 👎 and any edits. If we have alignment I'll draft the approval note for exec signoff (we should keep this under $20k net concession to avoid full CRO sign-off).

—Marissa
VP, West Coast Sales
Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Thanks for the thoughtful framing. My quick take: I'm comfortable with credits in the $7.5k–$10k range, but let's cap the immediate discount to ~12% (we're seeing margin pressure if we go deeper on price for smaller commits). If we want to get to 20% we'd need either a larger committed ARR or a bundled services component (paid onboarding).

Proposed final: $7,500 credits + 12% blended discount on month one; conditional $5k top-up on 3-month $25k/month commit signed within 14 days. That keeps our exposure under $20k (including credits) and gives them a clear runway.

Also: can legal confirm the signed_MSA has no trial/credit clauses that conflict? Jordan / Karthik, please flag asap if finance or legal require different wording (I can approve this for commercial).

—Aditya
Senior Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Sasha —

Appreciate the details and the usage report — great signal. We can approve a short exception on a combined credit + discount package with one condition. Final approval: 

- Free credits: $7,500 applied immediately to your accelerator account.
- Blended discount: 12% off month-one committed usage.
- Condition: to unlock an additional $5,000 credit top-up (bringing total credits to $12,500), Campfire must sign a 3-month committed spend of $25,000/month within 14 days of this email.
- We will grant the 3-week pilot extension as requested.

Next steps: please confirm acceptance by replying to this thread and countersigning the short SOW addendum (I've linked the editable doc here: https://drive.redwood.com/s/drive/Campfire-SOW-v3). Legal will issue a short approval letter once the SOW is countersigned.

I'm cc'ing Aditya, Karthik and Jordan for transparency. We expect to apply the credits within 48 hours of your confirmation.

—Marissa Cole
